featured_reviews.name: Bhaskar Jha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Can you imagine a 70 year old woman as a charlaton? That's Rama Jha for you. She is full of trickery. Her end goal is to get you to cough up money even though she will keep saying the opposite throughout the session. But a true swindler she is! If you go there to discuss your child's chart, she will get your and your wife's details too to double/triple her consultation fee.

She charges 5,100/= for General Consultation and 11,000/= for Medical Astrology consultation but hardly gives you any meaningful insight.. something which an alert individual already doesn't know. Whatever she says is not worth even for free. The value addition is a Big Zero.

At this price or even lower than this, you can get a better deal from top notch Indian/International astrologers. Just look up Quora/Astrology channels on YouTube.

She doesn't give you a full Janma Kundli with all sorts of charts such as D1, D9, D10, D4, etc and next 120 years of Maha/Antar/Pratyantar Dashas which any professional astrology service/software will provide you at a fraction of this price. Even in this age of Technology, she doesn't use any of the professional softwares and creates D1 chart by hand and will tell you the current dasha that you are running.. As a result, her dasha timings are off-mark.

3/4th of the time that we were there, she indulged in self-aggrandisement: how she is the best astrologer in the country, how internationally renowned she is, how TV channels queue up for her..

Your take away from her place would be your hand-written D1 chart without any Ascendant/Planetary degrees and a list of gems that you need to wear and a list of mantras that you need to chant.

She doesn't know how to frame an argument: how a conclusion has to be supported by logic and evidences. She will just drop statements but won't share the thought process on how she arrived at that statement. For example, a Retro Jupiter as per her is a Brahmin's curse. She has baseless notions about signs: how someone with a Scorpio ascendant wouldn't believe in astrology which is totally rubbish.

I feel disappointed that I got tricked by her and lost my hard-earned money. The fact that she is a senior citizen caught me off-guard.
